title: Tsirelson-compatible correlator composite nonuniqueness
claim_falsified: Euclidean local geometry + local tomography + local O(n) symmetry + exact CHSH Tsirelson value uniquely determine the centered correlator composite.
surviving_statement: For every n>=3, C_op={T:||T||_op<=1} and C_cap={T:||T||_op<=1, ||T||_*<=2} are distinct convex O(n)xO(n)-invariant centered binary-correlation bodies. Both contain every product correlator ab^T with ||a||,||b||<=1 and both attain CHSH=2*sqrt(2).
counterexample: I_3 is in C_op because ||I_3||_op=1 but not in C_cap because ||I_3||_*=3>2.
common_chsh_witness: Rank-two partial isometry aligned with the canonical CHSH coefficient; singular values (1,1,0,...), operator norm 1, nuclear norm 2, CHSH value 2*sqrt(2).
scope_warning: This is a centered binary-correlator-sector no-go. It does not by itself prove that C_cap has a unique or unrestricted full GPT state/effect extension.
prior_art_boundary: Tsirelson's CHSH bound, GPT tensor-product nonuniqueness, and norm duality are established mathematics. No historical novelty is claimed for those ingredients.
